body: This error was recently fixed, please update you cakephp core installation :)
The same error is present with "time" fields
@Bzounourz can you open a new issue with a test case if possible? And are you using the latest core?

Hello, yes, is the latest core (updated with composer). I am a beginner with GitHub, i look for open a new issue.

This problem (Validation error on "baked" date field) still exists and has been transferred to https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/pull/5723

@renardrouge Closed pull requests are not good places to track open issues. I've got a todo for looking at improving bake for nullable date fields, but the original issue here where an error is emitted from Validation::date() has been fixed. The time validation is a separate matter.
sorry mark,  of course, that error was corrected.   what i should have said was the general problem with a "baked" date field defined as "default null" still exists, and is continued in 5723.
